description: MainViewModel class in a Kotlin-based Android application managing app state, runtime initialization, and user interactions.

classes.name: MainViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel managing app state, runtime interactions, preferences, and user commands for the OpenClaw Android app.

methods.name: attachRuntimeUi
methods.description: Attaches lifecycle owner and permission requester to runtime components.

methods.name: setForeground
methods.description: Sets the foreground status of the runtime, reinitializing if necessary.

methods.name: setDisplayName
methods.description: Updates the display name preference.

methods.name: setCameraEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables camera feature.

methods.name: setLocationMode
methods.description: Sets the location mode.

methods.name: setLocationPreciseEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables precise location.

methods.name: setPreventSleep
methods.description: Prevents or allows device sleep.

methods.name: setManualEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables manual connection settings.

methods.name: setManualHost
methods.description: Sets manual host address.

methods.name: setManualPort
methods.description: Sets manual port.

methods.name: setManualTls
methods.description: Enables or disables TLS for manual connection.

methods.name: setGatewayToken
methods.description: Sets the gateway token.

methods.name: setGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Sets the bootstrap token for gateway.

methods.name: setGatewayPassword
methods.description: Sets the password for gateway connection.

methods.name: setOnboardingCompleted
methods.description: Marks onboarding as completed and initializes runtime if true.

methods.name: setCanvasDebugStatusEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables canvas debug status.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables notification forwarding.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingMode
methods.description: Sets notification package filter mode.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingPackagesCsv
methods.description: Sets notification packages from CSV string.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingQuietHours
methods.description: Configures quiet hours for notifications.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingMaxEventsPerMinute
methods.description: Sets max notification events per minute.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingSessionKey
methods.description: Sets session key for notification forwarding.

methods.name: handleAssistantLaunch
methods.description: Handles assistant launch requests and auto-sends prompts if requested.

methods.name: loadChat
methods.description: Loads chat session by key.

methods.name: refreshChat
methods.description: Refreshes current chat session.

methods.name: refreshChatSessions
methods.description: Refreshes chat sessions, optionally limiting the number.

methods.name: switchChatSession
methods.description: Switches to specified chat session.

methods.name: abortChat
methods.description: Aborts current chat.

methods.name: sendChat
methods.description: Sends a chat message with optional thinking and attachments.

methods.name: sendChatAwaitAcceptance
methods.description: Sends a chat message and waits for acceptance, returning success status.
